name: cuddlynest-search
description: Search CuddlyNest hotels and get listing details including live room prices and availability
long_description: An MCP server for searching CuddlyNest hotels and retrieving listing details. Static basics (name, location, description, amenities, images) are read from the listing page; room options, prices, availability and cancellation policies are streamed from CuddlyNest's wholesale-supplier WebSocket and accumulated across partial messages. Read-only: search and listing details only, no booking or payment. Respects robots.txt by default with an option to override for testing.

tools.name: cuddlynest_search
tools.description: Search CuddlyNest for hotels in a destination. Returns matching properties with links.

tools.name: cuddlynest_listing_details
tools.description: Get details for a specific CuddlyNest hotel: static basics plus live room options, prices, availability and cancellation policies.

ignore_robots_txt.title: Ignore robots.txt
ignore_robots_txt.description: Bypass robots.txt restrictions when fetching CuddlyNest listing pages. Use with caution and respect CuddlyNest's terms of service.

cuddlynest_ws_url.title: CuddlyNest WebSocket base URL (override)
cuddlynest_ws_url.description: Override the room-pricing WebSocket base URL (without ?access_token). Defaults to wss://ldp.cuddlynest.com/websocket/ldp_room_groups. Leave blank unless the endpoint moves.

cuddlynest_access_token.title: CuddlyNest app access token (optional)
cuddlynest_access_token.description: Anonymous RS256 JWT (sub 'web', ~1h TTL) for the pricing WebSocket. Leave blank to let the server scrape a fresh one from a CuddlyNest page; supply one to skip the scrape or if scraping fails.
